about_the_game:
The story of Hexagon Experiments is set on the planet Erythra, where 1k1 Corporation conducts experimental research. During one of these experiments, a test vehicle returning to Earth malfunctions and crashes into a settlement. A bacterium, brought to Earth for study, is released in the accident, infecting those investigating the crash site and triggering a spreading infection. The outbreak escalates to a global scale.

          Within 1k1 Corporation, two subsidiaries—1k1 Industries and 1k1 Genesis—develop the Zethrion 9 human prototype. To combat the pandemic, a cure must be developed on Erythra. A 300-day deadline is set to create the vaccine. During this period, Zethrion 9 operates in a central lab on Erythra, surrounded by greenhouses. Zethrion 9 is tasked with cultivating plants in these greenhouses to develop the cure.

           Additionally, an unexpected challenge arises: a shield covering a specific area deactivates at night due to power imbalances. When night falls, Zethrion 9 must defend the lab and plants from creatures roaming the planet.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 550 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT / GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: In Erythra, you have 300 days to develop a vaccine against a global pandemic! Grow plants in greenhouses, manage the lab, and defend it at night against wild creatures that breach the disabled shield. Time is running out—can you save humanity?
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian
*languages with full audio support
